title: Head of IT
summary: A head of IT leads the whole IT function in a mid-sized company or a division of a large one. They own infrastructure, network, enterprise applications such as ERP, the help desk, IT vendors and the IT budget, and keep systems secure and available. Larger firms split this into IT infrastructure and applications heads.
dailyDuties: Review uptime, tickets and SLAs with teams and vendors
Plan and track IT projects and ERP changes
Approve access, backup and DR checks
Plan the IT budget with finance
Lead and hire the IT team
typicalTitles: Director - Enterprise Applications and IT Infrastructure

skills.expectation: Set the IT strategy and roadmap
Run IT projects and enterprise applications
Manage IT vendors, contracts and licences
Run IT service management and the help desk
Hold vendors and teams to SLAs
Own backups, DR and business continuity for IT
Work with business heads and finance
Plan and track the IT budget
Run IT policies and ISMS with security
Move servers and apps to cloud

certifications.why: Listed as an advantage where IT also covers security.

sources.description: Drafted by CareerMetro from public India employer job posts and regulator notices on 2026-11-17. Awaiting domain-expert sign-off (L7 leadership role).
